body: A UPS Boeing 767-300 freighter, registration N306UP, operating flight 5X-904 from Louisville, Kentucky, to Los Angeles, California, diverted to Albuquerque, New Mexico, after its first officer fell ill in cruise. The aircraft was en route at FL360, about 80 nautical miles north of Albuquerque, when the captain decided to divert. The first officer was lightheaded and felt tingling in his extremities.
The aircraft landed safely on Albuquerque's runway 08 about 25 minutes later and taxied to the cargo apron, where medical services attended to the aircraft.
The aircraft remained on the ground for about 90 minutes, then continued to Los Angeles.
en.summary: A UPS Boeing 767 diverted to Albuquerque after its first officer fell ill in cruise; it landed safely and continued to Los Angeles after about 90 minutes on the ground.
en.title: UPS Boeing 767 diverts to Albuquerque after first officer falls ill

facts.claim: A UPS Boeing 767-300, registration N306UP, operating flight 5X-904 from Louisville to Los Angeles, was en route at FL360 about 80 nautical miles north of Albuquerque when the captain decided to divert due to a medical emergency with the first officer, who was lightheaded and felt tingling in his extremities.
The aircraft landed safely on Albuquerque's runway 08 about 25 minutes later and taxied to the cargo apron, where medical services attended to the aircraft.
The aircraft remained on the ground for about 90 minutes, then continued to Los Angeles.

body: UPS一架波音767-300貨機，註冊編號N306UP，執行5X-904班機自肯塔基州路易維爾飛往加州洛杉磯，在3萬6千英尺高度巡航、阿布奎基北方約80海里處，機長因副機師突發身體不適決定轉降。副機師感到頭暈、四肢麻木。
貨機約25分鐘後安全降落阿布奎基08跑道，滑向貨機坪由醫療人員接應。
貨機在地面停留約90分鐘後，繼續飛往洛杉磯。
zh.summary: UPS一架波音767貨機在巡航途中因副機師身體不適轉降阿布奎基，安全落地；地面停留約90分鐘後續飛洛杉磯。
zh.title: UPS波音767貨機副機師空中突感不適　轉降阿布奎基
